module: Editor extension that displays in the editor's main menu bar the error counter (red, suffix E) and warning counter (yellow, suffix W) of the development log, via Lua:getDevLogStats().
notes: The guard test uses `Lua.getDevLogStats` (dot) while the call uses `Lua:getDevLogStats()` (colon).
The code comment states that right-aligning in the bar (SameLine) no longer works: the text is displayed right after the menus.

onEditorMainMenuBar.desc: Main menu bar draw hook. Writes "LogStats:" then the number of errors and warnings if they are greater than 0. Does nothing if Lua.getDevLogStats does not exist.

windowSize.desc: Window size (unused: the SameLine line is commented out).
